name: arthurc0102
description: My personal agent marketplace: self-authored and curated third-party skills & plugins for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: ty-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server (ty) for type checking and code intelligence: ty from the active or project virtual environment, then from PATH, falling back to uvx.

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript language server that follows the workspace's TypeScript version: the native tsc --lsp for TypeScript 7+, typescript-language-server for older versions.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number steps, suppress tangents, restate state, make wins visible.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain any topic like I'm 5: a dead-simple HTML picture explainer with big visuals and few words. Use /eli5 <topic>.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads naturally without changing what it says.

plugins.name: shuorenhua-zh-tw
plugins.description: Clean AI-sounding patterns out of Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) text: remove AI tone, fix Mainland/Hong Kong terms and simplified-to-traditional conversion errors, and follow Taiwan punctuation and publishing conventions.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Upstash Context7 MCP server for up-to-date documentation lookup. Connects to Context7's hosted remote MCP server (https://mcp.context7.com/mcp) — no local Node.js or npx required — to pull version-specific documentation and code examples directly from source repositories into your LLM context. Works anonymously out of the box; set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for higher rate limits.

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

plugins.name: playground
plugins.description: Creates interactive HTML playgrounds — self-contained single-file explorers with visual controls, live preview, and prompt output with copy button. Includes templates for design playgrounds, data explorers, concept maps, and document critique.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering: grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more.
